english.title: Water undertaker fail to inform Authority of compensation paid or performance level
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a water undertaker failed, without reasonable excuse, to give information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), to the Authority as required by section 38A(2) of the Water Industry Act 1991
english.legislation: Contrary to section 38A(3) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a water undertaker
failed without reasonable excuse to inform the Authority
of the number of cases in which compensation was paid and the aggregate amount or value of that compensation
OR of the level of performance achieved by yourself as specified

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This precedent is to be superseded by section 29(2) and (5) of the Water Act 2014 although the section is yet to be in force
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being a water undertaker failed to give information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), to the Authority as required by section 38A(2) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
